Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 5

“Dhrishtaketu, Chekitana, the valiant king of Kashi, Purujit, Kuntibhoja, and Shaibya, the best of men.”

The list of Pandava commanders continues — each name would have carried weight and reputation for the original audience, signaling the seriousness of the force assembled against the Kauravas.
